Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :valid_tests.test_group is not null
then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'TEGRP'
 and code = :valid_tests.test_group
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('5011',:valid_tests.test_group );
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end if;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
check_null;
check_package_failure;
if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
then
 if :valid_tests.eff_date < sysdate
 then
 show_error ('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
if :valid_tests.term_date < :valid_tests.eff_date
then
 next_item;
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_NULL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_null is
begin
 break;
 if nvl(name_in(:system.trigger_field),'NULL') = 'NULL'

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block in ('VALID_TESTS','TEST_RESULTS')
then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 check_pass;
else
 do_key('key-others');
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block = 'VALID_TESTS'
then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('TEST_RESULTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 clear_block;
elsif :system.cursor_block = 'TEST_RESULTS'
then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('VALID_TESTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 clear_block;
else
 exit_form(no_validate);
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block = 'VALID_TESTS'
then
 enter;
 check_package_failure;
 next_block;
else
 do_key('key-others');
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_field = 'VALID_TESTS.TERM_DATE'
then
 next_block;
else
 NEXT_ITEM;
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-PRVBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_block = 'TEST_RESULTS'
then
 enter;
 check_package_failure;
 previous_block;
else
 do_key('key-others');
end if;
